newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - TBC to refocus operations.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - TBC to refocus operations.

text.p: This is the full text TBC Corp's press release.

MEMPHIS, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 23, 1996--TBC Corporation (Nasdaq/NM:TBCC) today announced that the decision to refocus the Company's future growth on the replacement tire business has led it to sell its aftermarket battery distribution subsidiary, Battery Associates Inc. The Company also said that it is discontinuing marketing other non-tire products to independent distributors, including custom wheels, ride-control products, filters, brake parts and chassis parts. TBC indicated that it anticipates a charge in the fourth quarter of approximately $2.3 million before taxes to reflect the one-time expenses related to these actions. TBC indicated that these changes will have no impact on the tires and other products marketed through the Big O Tires subsidiary which was acquired in July 1996.

Louis S. DiPasqua, President and Chief Executive Officer, stated, "Our decision to concentrate TBC's managerial and financial resources solely on the replacement tire market is a solid strategy because, simply, it is what we do best. Although non-tire products accounted for 9% of our total sales of $548 million in 1995, they did not contribute significantly to net income. TBC remains the largest independent marketing organization in the replacement tire industry. We recognize the competitiveness of the market we serve, but are confident about the opportunities to capitalize on our relative size in a consolidating industry. The integration of Big O Tires into our corporate performance and planning this year has helped provide the catalyst for this step. We are excited about the prospects for a continuation of Big O's growth and are firmly committed to regaining a consistent pattern of gains within TBC's core tire operations."
TBC Corporation is one of the nation's largest marketers and distributors of products for the automotive replacement market.
